description: Change fields of an existing event; only the fields you pass are sent. Changing start/end needs timezone too. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/.

capacity.description: Event capacity. Omit to use the sum of the ticket class capacities.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency (not changeable after paid sales).

end_utc.description: New end time, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

hide_end_date.description: Hide the end date from attendees.

hide_start_date.description: Hide the start date from attendees.

invite_only.description: Only invited people can see the event page. Mutually exclusive with listed.

online_event.description: True if the event is online-only (no venue). Cannot be combined with venue_id.

organizer_id.description: Organizer profile ID. Omit to use the default organizer.

show_remaining.description: Show the number of tickets left on the event page.

start_utc.description: New start time, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

summary.description: Plain-text summary, max 140 characters (Eventbrite's replacement for the old description field).

timezone.description: Olson timezone of the event, e.g. America/Los_Angeles or Europe/London.

name: eventbrite_update_event
title: Update an event
